description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 007 build an open cell terracotta jali wall, with the deep square cells shown in the product photo, for spaces where airflow and shade matter more than full privacy.

## How it looks
The photo shows a wall of large, open square cells with noticeable depth. Deep cells tend to block low-angle sun and side views while still letting plenty of air through, and they cast strong shadows that change across the day. The plain clay colour keeps the look honest and simple.

## Where it works
- **Jali wall for ventilation** around stairwells, car porches, laundry areas and service yards.
- **Open square jali screen** on a terrace or rooftop to cut glare and wind without closing the view.
- **Deep cell jali** as a sun screen in front of west-facing windows.

In Pakistan's hot summers, a deep open screen in front of a wall or window can help keep direct sun off the surface behind it; how much cooler it feels depends on orientation and spacing, so ask your architect.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Pattern: open square cells with depth (from the product photo)
- Size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them before you plan the wall.

Open cells can collect dust and leaves outdoors, so rinse the wall occasionally with water and a soft brush. A long or tall wall usually needs pillars or a frame; agree the detail with your contractor.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your wall size for a dated quote. Read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide), the [clay products in construction guide](/blog/clay-products-in-building-construction-bricks-tiles-and-terracotta), or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of an open cell terracotta jali wall?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Does a jali wall help with ventilation and heat?
faqs.a: A jali wall lets air move through and can keep direct sun off the wall or window behind it. How much difference it makes depends on orientation and spacing, which your architect can advise on.

faqs.q: Open cell jali or patterned jali: which gives more privacy?
faqs.a: Small or patterned openings give more privacy; large open cells give more airflow and light. Deep cells help by blocking side views even when the openings are large.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 007" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
